newsitem.title: USA: Viasoft to acquire Germany's R&O.
newsitem.headline: Viasoft to acquire Germany's R&O.

text.p: Viasoft Inc has signed an agreement to acquire Germany's Rottger & Osterberg Software-Technik GmbH, a privately-held provider of client/server repository technology, a company statement said Tuesday.
The statement said Viasoft will acquire all of the outstanding shares of R&O for about $29.3 million in cash and stock. Viasoft will also assume certain debt totalling some $4 million.
It said the company would pay up to $4 million if R&O met established revenue targets between the closing of the deal and June 30, 1997.
Viasoft, which helps companies manage information, expects to close the transaction during the second quarter of fiscal 1997, it added.
